profile.headline: Lead Principal Platform Software Engineer at Oracle | Distributed Systems, Cloud Security, Identity, Reliability & AI Automation | AWS/OCI
profile.summary:
I design and lead secure, high-availability platforms that make complex products easier to build, operate, and evolve.

Over 20 years in software engineering, I’ve led architecture and modernization initiatives across healthcare, connected-home IoT, live streaming, security, and digital media. My work spans technical strategy, distributed systems, identity and authorization, cloud infrastructure, reliability engineering, incident response, and hands-on software delivery.

Selected impact:
• Led identity and privacy services used by 180+ engineering teams, operating at 1.8M requests per second with 7ms p99 latency.
• Delivered zero-downtime platform, compute, API, and network migrations for systems processing hundreds of thousands of requests per second.
• Owned Ring services handling more than 800M asynchronous events per day.
• Defined an OpenTelemetry strategy projected to eliminate $2.5M in licensing costs.
• Built authorization platforms, cloud reliability practices, incident-management processes, and technical roadmaps supporting products used by millions of customers.
• Currently lead AI automation and OCI modernization initiatives focused on security, reliability, engineering productivity, and compliance.

My strength is turning ambiguous, cross-organizational problems into clear technical direction and staying close enough to the architecture, code, and operations to ensure the solution works in production.

Focus areas: Platform Engineering | Distributed Systems | Cloud Architecture | Security and Identity | Reliability Engineering | AWS | OCI | Go | Java | Python | TypeScript | AI Automation

positions.title: Lead Principal Platform Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead the architecture, product strategy, and delivery of AI-assisted incident-response and communications platforms within Oracle Health Cloud Engineering, with an emphasis on secure design, operational reliability, and organization-wide adoption.

• Own the product and technical direction for an incident-response communications platform, defining the MVP, logical architecture, use cases, authorization model, executive demonstration, and delivery roadmap.
• Established the initial delivery team by onboarding new engineers and introducing a structured execution cadence.
• Advanced the platform through cloud security and architecture review.
• Aligned engineering, operations, and product stakeholders on MVP use cases and success metrics for automated incident messaging, multi-client communications, and AI-assisted summaries.
• Serve as a Change Review Board architect, evaluating production changes for security, reliability, customer impact, and operational readiness.

positions.title: Sr. Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the architecture and production delivery of AI-enabled engineering-support platforms while advancing cloud security and operational governance across Oracle Health Cloud Engineering.

• Took an AI-enabled engineering-support platform from proof of concept through production, owning the solution architecture, delivery backlog, test strategy, and rollout plan.
• Delivered the platform ahead of schedule and demonstrated it to Oracle SVPs, validating its potential to improve engineering-support efficiency.
• Built an AI-assisted Slack support experience projected to save 222 engineering hours - approximately 28 person-days - over six months while providing continuous support across time zones.
• Founded and grew a 100-member internal AI community, authored four AI initiatives, and incorporated proposals from two additional teams into a broader organizational AI strategy.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer, SDE III (L6) - Ring Site Platform
positions.description:
Technical lead for the Ring Site Platform team, responsible for foundational services and shared infrastructure supporting Ring’s customer-facing web applications across multiple regions.

• Designed, developed, and delivered a shared TypeScript AuthorizationProvider library for role-based access control across Ring web applications.
• Built a service-reliability framework incorporating monitoring, service-level documentation, operational readiness, and structured on-call practices.
• Led performance and deployment-risk initiatives, including code-splitting optimizations and safer release practices for critical web services.
• Developed technical strategies, architecture specifications, and roadmaps connecting authorization, platform reliability, and developer productivity with business priorities.
• Improved incident management through detailed postmortems, preventive measures, and clearly assigned follow-up work.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer, SDE III (L6) - Twitch Users Platform
positions.description:
Technical lead for Twitch’s Users team, responsible for identity and privacy services used by more than 180 internal engineering teams. The platform operated at 1.8 million requests per second with 7ms p99 latency.

• Led the zero-downtime migration of a critical user service from Amazon Linux 1 to Amazon Linux 2 while handling approximately 800,000 requests per second.
• Directed a broad platform modernization spanning REST-to-Twirp APIs, Jenkins-to-Amazon CI/CD, Elastic Beanstalk-to-ECS compute, and VPC Peering-to-PrivateLink networking.
• Migrated Twitch production traffic without customer downtime using dual PrivateLink connections, production-scale load testing, and carefully managed rollout controls.
• Defined technical strategy, decomposed complex programs into actionable backlogs, and coordinated implementation across partner teams.
• Authored detailed architecture specifications, operational plans, and migration documentation for high-risk production changes.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer, SDE III (L6) - Ring Alarm
positions.description:
Technical lead, primary developer, and service owner for distributed Ring Alarm services processing more than 800 million asynchronous events per day.

• Owned multiple production microservices and more than 150,000 lines of code, including target architecture, technical backlog, observability, code review, and 24/7 operational support.
• Delivered Ring Alarm integrations with Alexa Smart Home, Amazon Astro, Amazon Key, and Ring Always Home Cam.
• Developed key Ring Alarm Pro capabilities, including 24/7 backup internet and real-time customer notifications, using Go and Java.
• Defined the strategy for replacing Datadog across the Ring Alarm platform and implemented distributed tracing and application metrics with OpenTelemetry.
• Produced an observability solution projected to save $2.5 million in licensing costs.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer, SDE II (L5) - Ring Alarm
positions.description:
Software Development Engineer responsible for high-scale cloud services and platform integrations supporting Ring Alarm and the broader connected-home ecosystem.

• Led the Ring Alarm integration with Alexa Smart Home, enabling device discovery and security-panel control using Go and AWS services.
• Developed Ring platform-mode capabilities serving more than 10 million daily users.
• Built a device-linking system processing approximately 800 million daily events using Java, Spring Boot, Amazon SQS, and AWS infrastructure.
• Established the cloud-platform load-testing strategy and supporting automation for more than 10 microservices.
• Designed and delivered highly available microservices involving authentication, authorization, device state, notifications, and connected-home integrations.
